sentences.text: My watch showed the living room stayed below 18.0 °C from 00:50 to 06:00, with the coldest time being 05:40 at 17.2 °C.
The bathroom also stayed below 18.0 °C between 01:20 and 06:00, reaching 17.5 °C at 05:10.
Since both rooms were below 18.0 °C, please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Because of the low temperatures shown in C1 and C2, perhaps checking the heating would be a kind idea.
